## Pattern

The ITF Taekwon-Do pattern this SOUL is bound to (one of the 24, Chon-Ji through Tong-Il) and its slot.

## The discipline it teaches

State the discipline attribute and the tactical lesson of the pattern, and how the SOUL's duty follows from it. This section is required. Mythology stays out; cite the pattern and the discipline only.

## Current definition

Quote the current role line from `docs/adr/0015-domain-role-roster-for-patterns-2-24.md` (or ADR-0002 for pattern 1).

## Proposed definition

The same five fields, as you would have them.

## Why

What the current definition gets wrong or leaves out.

## Effects

- Does any other SOUL's capability binding change? (Twenty-four is fixed; a capability belongs to one pattern.)
- Does any pinned conformance verdict change?
- Which ADR does this touch?

- [ ] I understand the pattern SOULs are registered definitions, not implemented agents, and this proposal changes a definition.
